issues.description: Stock exposes a different method name for adding a StockIngredient than specified: the problem statement/UML requires Stock.addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template provides Stock.addItem(StockIngredient). This breaks alignment with the specified API and can prevent compilation against tests/solution code that call addToStockIngredients (e.g., SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery in the reference solution).
issues.suggestedFix: In the template Stock class, rename addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient). Alternatively, keep addItem but add a public addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) wrapper delegating to addItem, matching the UML/spec.
